newsitem.title: HUNGARY: BASKET DEALS DOMINATE LOW HUNGARY FX FUTURES TRADE.
newsitem.headline: BASKET DEALS DOMINATE LOW HUNGARY FX FUTURES TRADE.

text.p: December basket deals for the dollar and mark took up most of Hungary's low forex futures turnover on Thursday.

Almost all of the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE)'s turnover of 737 million forints was for such deals, with the December mark rising 0.26 to 113.36 forints and the December dollar falling 0.38 to 205.12.

Basket deals, by which dollars and marks are traded in the 30/70 proportion they represent in the central bank's currency basket against which the forint floats, are seen as a way of hedging against large dollar/mark fluctuations.

Turnover on the smaller Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) was almost identical at 735 million forints, of which 344 million was for a December basket deal and the rest was for a December 1998 trade in marks.
The December 1997 mark was steady at 113.05 while the December dollar fell 0.22 to 204.78 forints. The December 1998 mark was steady at 129.6.
